Date: 2028-07-23T15:12:00Z
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@integralhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Subject: CSM handoff: integration liftoff + developer checklist

Hi Sofia — great meeting earlier.

As discussed, looping in the Implementation team to kick off the integration. Attached is the integration-runbook v1 and a draft SOW for internal alignment. High-level items we covered:
- Authentication: API key initially; will move to token-based rotation by go-live
- Endpoints: starting with the /v1/generate endpoints, then embeddings roll-out
- Rate limits: expected burst of ~200rps during initial sync, steady-state ~30rps
- Retries/timeouts: client should implement exponential backoff with jitter; see notes below

Requested next steps (please):
1) Marissa: propose 2 options for a 60-minute kickoff (this week) and include an agenda
2) Vivek: provide a minimal SDK snippet and recommended timeout/retry defaults for their engineers
3) Sofia/Roberto: share dev Slack channel and procurement contact for SOW updates

Attachments: integration-runbook-v1.pdf, sow-draft.docx

Thanks — I’ll transition ownership to Marissa after kickoff.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

+1 415-555-0182

Date: 2028-07-25T18:04:00Z
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Lopez <s.lopez@integralhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Roberto Martinez <r.martinez@integralhealth.com>, procurement@integralhealth.com
Subject: Re: CSM handoff: integration liftoff + developer checklist

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent for Thu 2028-08-28 15:00 PT (60m) with Zoom link and the draft agenda.

To answer Sofia's questions quickly:
- Embeddings batch guidance: start with batches of 256 items (or ~25k tokens) for the first load; scale up in 2x increments while monitoring 429s and token billing.
- Ramp plan: day 0 (import) limit to 2 concurrent batch requests for first 2 hours; day 1 increase to 4 concurrent; day 2 onwards move to steady-state target concurrency based on observed latency.

We will also include a short section in the kickoff on how to use prefix/KV caching to reduce tokens during iterative prompts. Vivek will post the example repo in the Slack channel after the meeting.

Action items:
- Monica: finalize SOW comments and re-upload Word version to the Drive (Monica)
- Roberto/procurement: review SOW by Mon 2028-07-30
- Vivek: share example repo link in Slack post-kickoff

Looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Marissa
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
